description: This file defines the JSON Schema and API interface for the VoiceControl plugin, including methods, events, and data structures used for managing voice sessions, configuring the voice stack, and handling message exchange with the voice server.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures the voice stack with URLs, device enabling options, and protocol parameters. Supports multiple URL schemes for different protocols.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a custom message to the Voice Server, such as context or ASR blobs, identified by message type and session ID.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Sets application-specific metadata in the voice session initiation message, including capabilities and language.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Simulates a voice session with a provided transcription, mainly for QA and automation testing. Triggered events include session begin, stream begin/end, and server messages.

methods.name: voiceSessionTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the supported voice session request types, such as transcription, audio file, stream, and factory tests.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Requests a voice session with specific parameters like transcription, audio file, application name, and request type.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates an active voice session using its session ID.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts a subsequent audio stream for an existing voice session.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of the voice stack, including URLs, capabilities, and device statuses.
